cards.prompt: Spending most of your time online and overthinking social outreach is a reliable way to sharpen your social skills.
cards.answer: Myth: these habits stifle social skills and connections.

cards.prompt: Someone feels lonely and negative, so they always open content platforms or watch porn instead of reaching out. What outcome should they expect?
cards.answer: They will stifle their social skills, feel uncomfortable around people, and find real interaction terrifying.

cards.prompt: What happens to your references when you only consume online content, according to this satirical guide?
cards.answer: You make niche online references that nobody gets.

cards.prompt: Which habit below is listed as a way to become anti-social?
options: Constantly analyzing other people's perception of you
cards.answer: Constantly analyzing others' perception of you is one of the listed habits.

cards.prompt: You feel negative and want to open Reddit. Applying this post in reverse, what better habit should you try?
cards.answer: Avoid escaping online; instead reach out to real people without overthinking it, to build social skills.
